topology_reasoning.description: The target geometry is a 4-input adiabatic-style power-combiner: four narrow (~1.2 um) input stripes at the top of the design merge into one wide central body (~19.4 um) and then narrow down into one output guide (~2.3 um). Function is directional combining/funneling, not an interferometer splitter. The design behavior is set mainly by the input guide spacing, input width and launch heights, the merge transfer length/width envelope, and final output taper length/width.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive rectangle reconstruction with four inputs, merge slab, stepped taper, and output tail.
Parameterized and top-level-tunable pass; geometry unchanged due equivalent calibration offseting.
Adjusted merge/taper extents and shifted merged envelope to recover centerline, which worsened overlap.
Adjusted merge width and output transition to reduce side lobes; IoU dropped further.
Moved anchors and rebalanced output widths to improve merge/taper overlap versus target.
Added flip_y mapping for compare alignment, probe rectangle for verify contract, and metadata-stable output constraints; this became the best match.
